name: crafthall-optimize
description: Count your Claude Code token use, get ranked fixes to try (estimated, not measured), and measure one setup change with paired runs of your own tasks. A comparison shows its plan and expected cost first and runs only after you confirm. Optimize itself sends nothing to Crafthall; comparisons are ordinary Claude Code runs on your own account.
